validated_results.title: Cancer incidence and mortality risk: associations with diet quality scores in a predominantly low-income and Black cohort study.
validated_results.journal: The American journal of clinical nutrition
validated_results.reason: Prospective cohort study of DASH diet quality score and prostate cancer incidence in the Southern Community Cohort Study, so the exposure and incident outcome match the request; only a prostate cancer mortality estimate is numerically reported, but a missing effect size is not grounds for exclusion.
